primitives.description: Pure, reusable building blocks without side effects.

rules.description: Primitives MUST NOT perform I/O or have side effects
Primitives MUST be deterministic and pure
Primitives MUST be testable without mocks
Kernel contains orchestration only, no business rules
Kernel owns and controls system lifecycle states
Kernel MUST NOT contain domain or business logic

modules.description: Reusable functional units with domain or infrastructure logic.

rules.description: Domain modules MUST NOT depend on adapters
Domain modules MUST declare explicit dependencies
Infrastructure modules MUST NOT contain business rules

common_rules.description: Modules MUST declare setup explicitly via ModuleMeta
Module public APIs are stable contracts

rules.description: Adapters MUST NOT implement business or domain logic
Adapters MUST be thin translation layers only
Adapters ARE framework-specific and replaceable
Modules MUST NOT depend on adapters
All errors MUST extend BaseError
Error codes MUST be namespaced (module:reason)
Error messages MUST be safe to log (no sensitive data)
HTTP status in meta is a hint, not a dependency

errors.note: Comity uses exceptions for both expected and unexpected failures. For expected failures, consider Result<T,E> pattern as future enhancement.

rules.description: Public APIs MUST be intentional, stable, and documented
Internal APIs MUST NOT be exported or documented
Behavior exposure SHOULD use Facade pattern
Sub-entrypoints MUST represent clear conceptual domains
Events are observational and MUST NOT influence control flow
System MUST function correctly without event listeners
Event payloads MUST be safe to log (identifiers, not objects)
Hooks are participatory and MAY influence control flow
Hook execution order MAY matter
Hooks are part of lifecycle contracts

separation_rule.description: Events MUST NOT trigger hooks; Hooks MAY emit events

rules.description: Tests MUST validate contracts and behavior, not implementations
Testing approach MUST vary by architectural layer
Primitives tests MUST be pure and deterministic with zero mocks
Adapter tests MAY use integration-style tests and real frameworks
README.md MUST follow standard structure (Purpose, Scope, Public API)
Detailed documentation MUST live in docs/ directory
Design decisions documented as topic files, not formal ADRs
All public APIs MUST be documented
Internal APIs MUST NOT be documented
All fields MUST be declared explicitly (no parameter properties)
Internal state MUST use #private JavaScript fields
Public state MUST be exposed via getters
Constructor MUST fully initialize the instance
Classes with phases MUST use Lifecycle abstraction

infrastructure_logic.description: Non-business logic required to enforce protocol, runtime safety, or invariants.

rules.description: Infrastructure logic (middleware flow control, protocol invariants, safety checks) is NOT business logic.
Infrastructure logic MAY live in internal/, middleware/, pipeline/, or facade implementations.
Architectural boundaries MUST be clear and enforced
Public contracts MUST be stable and versioned
Adapters MUST be thin, framework-specific, and replaceable
Modules MUST be composable and explicitly declare dependencies
Kernel orchestrates, modules provide functionality, adapters translate
